build_retri_dataloader: build a retrieval dataloader using ShardedHow2MetaProcessor, ShardedVideoProcessor, and MMDataset for distributed training
retrive_candidates: run the retrieval model to extract and sync video candidates across distributed GPUs for a given epoch
run_video_predict_loop: run the VideoPredictor predict_loop to encode video features and finalize the FAISS retriver index
run_video_retri_predict_loop: run the VideoRetriPredictor predict_loop to search candidate videos by video IDs and save batched results as pickle
reshape_subsample: reshape and flat subsample tensors in a sample dict by squeezing dimension-0 size-1 tensors
